operations.name: list_vendor_invoices
operations.description: List vendor invoices with a given status, newest first, at most 50.
operations.sql: SELECT id, vendor_name, amount_cents, currency, hours, description, status, created_at FROM vendor_invoices WHERE status = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

operations.name: record_vendor_invoice
operations.description: Record an invoice a vendor sent, for finance to review. Never marks anything paid.
operations.sql: INSERT INTO vendor_invoices (vendor_name, amount_cents, currency, hours, description) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id, status, created_at

params.name: vendor_name
params.description: Vendor's name as they gave it.

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Invoice total in minor units, e.g. 45000 for 450.00.

params.name: hours
params.description: Hours worked, when the vendor gave them.
